parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of offset dash linestyle not having an effect in patch objects. The change is minimal and focused.

issues.description: The patch introduces a change in style that does not match the existing code conventions, specifically the removal of the parentheses around the tuple in the _setattr_cm call.
